people.name: Fan Chang Yu
people.note: Lin'an's pig butcher, then the 'Butcher Lady of Jizhou', Flower-Pinned General, Grand General of Huaihua

people.name: Xie Zheng / Marquis of Wu'an
people.note: Hides as 'Yan Zheng', a refugee, in her house; son of General Xie Lin Shan, dead at Jinzhou; Prince Regent at the end

people.name: Fan Chang Ning
people.note: 'Ning Niang', the frail little sister

people.name: Wei Qi Lin / Fan Er Niu
people.note: The butcher father, dead before the story; once one of the 'Two Tigers of the Wei Family'

people.name: Mr. Zhao
people.note: Doctor for people and livestock; drafted as the army's vet

people.name: Yu Qian Qian
people.note: Owner of the Yixiang restaurant; Empress Dowager Mingde at the end

people.name: Yu Bao Er
people.note: The imperial great-grandson, hidden in a cellar; crowned Qi Yu at the end

people.name: Song Yan
people.note: The scholar next door; two actors play him, one the face, one the body

people.name: Jin Yuan Bao
people.note: Lin'an's thug, then a soldier

people.name: Man Di
people.note: The one who does not come home

people.name: Gongsun Yin
people.note: Headmaster of Luyuan Academy; the army's strategist

people.name: Tao Yi
people.note: Grand Tutor, former Minister of Works — met as an old quarry labourer

people.name: He Jing Yuan
people.note: Prefect and general of Jizhou; falls holding Lucheng

people.name: Li Huai An / Wen Kan
people.note: Zhenwei Commandant of Jizhou, the Grand Tutor Li's eldest grandson

people.name: Qi Sheng
people.note: Emperor of Yin, a puppet between the Wei and Li clans; ends mad behind his throne

people.name: Qi Shu
people.note: Grand princess; a scholar 'An Xu' at Luyuan, a physician at the front

people.name: Wei Yan
people.note: Chancellor of Yin, courtesy name Yi Gui; put the emperor on the throne seventeen years ago; his assistant Wei Sheng fires the cold arrow at the end

people.name: Wei Xuan
people.note: The Chancellor's son, a reckless commander in the northwest

people.name: Qi Rong Yin / Consort Shu
people.note: The late emperor's consort, dead before the story

people.name: Li Jing
people.note: Grand Tutor of Yin, head of the Li clan; sold the East Palace's secret to the late emperor

people.name: Qi Min / Sui Yuan Huai
people.note: Prince Changxin's eldest son, met as 'Master Qi' the rice merchant; afraid of fire, never lights a lamp

people.name: Sui Yuan Qing
people.note: Prince Changxin's second son and heir

people.name: Sui Tuo / Prince Changxin
people.note: The rebel lord of Chongzhou

people.name: Shi San Niang
people.note: Chief of the Qingfeng Fort bandits

people.name: Nanny Lan
people.note: Once the crown princess's maid

people.name: Zhao Xun
people.note: The Lin'an rice shop manager — Qi Min's man, keeper of the East Palace seal

links.label: found him dying in the snow, holding a jade hairpin like her mother's, and carried him home
links.evidence: she notices he is holding a jade hairpin identical to one her mother once owned. Sensing this might be a sign from her mother's spirit, she decides to save him

links.label: a matrilocal marriage to keep the house from her uncle — fake, and the whole lane fooled
links.evidence: The wedding ceremony proceeded with traditional rituals, including the "sharing of the meal" (Tonglao) and drinking wine together

links.label: sent him off to war with a divorce letter — then went to the front and found him in a tent
links.evidence: Changyu, having anticipated his departure, presented him with travel essentials and a divorce letter, suggesting a clean break would allow him more freedom

links.label: the kiss she returns, in the tent where she nurses him
links.evidence: Xie Zheng leaned in to kiss her, and after a brief surprise, Changyu warmly returned the gesture

links.label: drugged his medicine and took his place in the line, and killed Shi Hu there
links.evidence: she drugged his medicine, knocking him unconscious... Dressing herself in a soldier's uniform, Changyu took his place as a swordsman in the Left Guard

links.label: the frail 'Yan Zheng' she married was the Marquis of Wu'an all along — she learns it when the army cheers him
links.evidence: Watching the man she knew as Yan Zheng receive the army's ultimate respect, Changyu was struck with the realization that he was the Marquis

links.label: forged her a pair of twin blades and tempered them in his own blood
links.evidence: Xie Zheng cut his own hand to offer his blood to the forge. He knew that only Fan Changyu possessed the strength and spirit to truly master these blades

links.label: at his parents' graves, bleeding from his uncle's lashes, he names her his lifelong partner; she calls herself the Lady Marquis
links.evidence: Changyu declared herself the Lady Marquis... He then formally introduced Changyu to his parents' spirits, swearing that she was his lifelong partner

links.label: Prince Regent and Grand General; five years on, parents of two, riding out together against the Beijue
links.evidence: Fan Changyu, now a mother of two but with her skills undiminished, donned her armor once more. She and Xie Zheng prepared to ride out together

links.label: younger sister
links.evidence: [Chang Yu's sister] / 樊長玉的妹妹，乳名「寧娘」

links.label: carries her through the lantern festival like the other fathers do; she calls him brother-in-law in front of an army
links.evidence: Xie Zheng insisted on carrying the girl, noting that all the other children were being carried by their fathers or brothers

links.label: her father, the butcher who taught her his glaive technique
links.evidence: [Chang Yu's father]

links.label: was Wei Qi Lin, the general branded Jinzhou's traitor — she learns it from He Jing Yuan's last letter, and beats the Drum of Appeal for him
links.evidence: The contents confirm her fears: her father was indeed Wei Qilin, the man infamous for betraying the army at Jinzhou

links.label: his most loyal subordinate, sent with the real tiger seal for reinforcements — then framed as Jinzhou's traitor to save the Wei family
links.evidence: Wei Yan had entrusted the real Tiger Seal to his most loyal subordinate, Wei Qilin... To save the Wei family from execution, Wei Yan was forced to frame Wei Qilin as a traitor

links.label: old comrades — He pressed him to suicide on Wei Yan's orders, and kept his daughters safe after
links.evidence: He Jingyuan admitted that Fan Erniu was his former comrade and had committed suicide after being pressured by He Jingyuan himself, who was acting under Wei Yan's orders

links.label: the neighbours who nurse her stranger, defend her gate with brooms and call themselves the guardians of Xigu Lane
links.evidence: [Chang Yu's neighbor]

links.label: married
links.evidence: [Chang Yu's neighbor] / [Chang Yu's neighbor]

links.label: washes her floor mat so she has to share her husband's bed
links.evidence: She intentionally washed the floor mat Changyu usually slept on, leaving her with no choice but to share the bed with her husband

links.label: back in Lin'an, she calls the Zhaos her foster parents
links.evidence: she reunited with Mister and Madam Zhao, officially calling them her foster parents and promising to care for them

links.label: the ex-fiancé whose family lived off hers for ten years, then called off the match over a fortune-teller
links.evidence: The Song family had unilaterally called off the engagement after a fortune teller labeled Changyu a "star of ill omen"

links.label: wipes his name off the lanterns, then sacks him in an alley with Xie Zheng
links.evidence: They threw a sack over the scholar's head and gave him a thorough beating, fleeing before Changning could even finish counting to seven

links.label: the restaurant owner who takes her braised meat, then opens a shop with her
links.evidence: Yu Qianqian expressed interest in doing business with Changyu's braised meat, as she had been secretly testing the quality of Changyu's products for ten days

links.label: her son, kept hidden in a locked cellar
links.evidence: [Qian Qian's son] / 育有一子俞寶兒

links.label: playmates — hide-and-seek in a chest, a pendant and a woven grasshopper exchanged
links.evidence: Changning and Yu Qianqian's son, Baoer, become friends and hide inside a large chest in Qi Min's room during a game of hide-and-seek

links.label: the boy emperor pinky-swears to make her his Empress, the whole world as betrothal gift
links.evidence: He even made a pinky swear to make her his Empress one day, promising the entire world as her betrothal gift

links.label: the concubine who fled him six years ago — he finds her at the Yixiang, and she knows his voice before his face
links.evidence: Qi Min reveals to his subordinate Zhao Xun that he has been searching for her for six years

links.label: his son — whom he terrorises, and would kill out of jealousy of his place in her heart
links.evidence: This confirmed Qi Min's suspicion that Baoer was indeed his son

links.label: drugs him and flees; later steals the tiger tally from his neck
links.evidence: Taking advantage of the moment, Yu Qianqian drugged Qi Min and fled the villa toward the outskirts of Lucheng

links.label: brings him the poisoned soup in his cell; he drinks it from her hand, saying she alone never feared his face
links.evidence: Knowing it was poisoned, Qi Min drank it willingly, even asking her to feed him... he died in her arms

links.label: the crown prince's true son — swapped at the East Palace fire and raised as Changxin's heir
links.evidence: That son, the true Imperial Grandson, was alive and living as Lord Changxin's eldest son, Sui Yuanhuai

links.label: raised as brothers, Changxin's two sons
links.evidence: The two brothers, Sui Yuanhuai and Sui Yuanqing, met shortly after

links.label: lured him to Lin'an so the Marquis would kill the heir; later stabs him in a derelict temple
links.evidence: Qi Min, twisted by trauma, had lured Sui Yuanqing to Lin'an, hoping Xie Zheng would kill the heir and clear Qi Min's path to the throne

links.label: the eldest son he never loved, told the throne would never be his
links.evidence: He coldly declared that even if something happened to Yuanqing, the throne would never belong to Yuanhuai

links.label: kills the nanny who raised him when she turns to take Bao'er to Xie Zheng
links.evidence: In a fit of cold-blooded rage, Qi Min killed the woman who had raised him

links.label: poses as an East Palace survivor to buy the Marquis's alliance — 200,000 shi of grain as deposit
links.evidence: Instead of turning Xie Zheng over to the Wei family, Qi Min decided to use his East Palace seal to lure the Marquis into an alliance

links.label: exposes his pact with the Beijue at the Xuan Gate; the usurper falls from the wall
links.evidence: Xie Zheng publicly exposes Qi Min's secret alliance with the Beijue tribes, revealing that the prince was willing to hand over the dynasty's lands to barbarians

links.label: the Li clan's secret candidate for the throne — the alliance the grandson finds unfit
links.evidence: Qi Min warns him that their alliance is the only way for the Li family to survive the struggle against Wei Yan

links.label: his man in Lin'an, behind the rice shop counter
links.evidence: Qi Min reveals to his subordinate Zhao Xun that he has been searching for her for six years

links.label: flees with Bao'er and the East Palace seal, and tells the Marquis who set the fire
links.evidence: Zhao Xun revealed a shocking truth to Xie Zheng: the fire at the East Palace years ago had been set by the Crown Princess herself

links.label: mother
links.evidence: he locks Yu Qianqian in a woodshed and interrogates Granny Lan's son, Zhao Xun

links.label: the nanny who smuggles the imperial great-grandson out of Baxia
links.evidence: In the Sui manor, Yu Qianqian coordinates with Granny Lan to smuggle her son, Bao'er, to safety

links.label: the rebel heir the Marquis shoots off a cliff, then baits into a flood with a thousand men
links.evidence: an enraged Xie Zheng shot him, sending him plummeting off the cliff into the water

links.label: buys the Qingfeng bandits to massacre Lin'an and corner her — she jumps
links.evidence: The pursuit of Changyu ended at the edge of a cliff, where Sui Yuanqing cornered her and demanded her submission. Changyu responded with a defiant smile and threw herself into the abyss

links.label: holds her hostage as 'Xie Zheng's daughter', for the territory of Yanzhou
links.evidence: Sui Yuanqing was delighted, seeing the girl as the perfect leverage to use against Xie Zheng

links.label: second son and named heir
links.evidence: The second-born son of rebel Prince Changxin, he is the crown prince of the rebel faction

links.label: the bandit chief who fell for him after one kiss; dying, he admits he never loved her
links.evidence: In a bold move, he kissed the female chief, causing Shi Sanniang—who was impressed by his strength and handsome looks—to fall for him

links.label: brings her Sui Yuan Qing's head and a tiger seal, as he asked
links.evidence: Shi Sanniang brought Sui Yuanqing's head and another Tiger Seal

links.label: slays the rebel lord in a duel, with her father's technique he recognises too late
links.evidence: Fan Changyu combines these refined movements with her own butcher's knife skills to finally slay the rebel Lord

links.label: the gambling-den thug her uncle brings to seize the house — beaten twice, then calling her 'Great-Auntie Fan'
links.evidence: Changyu's uncle, Fan Daniu, has brought a group of gambling den thugs led by Jin Yuanbao to her home to seize the house deed

links.label: the Northwest Pig Butcher Squad, formed in a stone quarry
links.evidence: Jin Yuanbao and his followers—Man Di, Man Cang, and Man Wu—arrived just in time to defend her

links.label: loves her in silence; sees her leave the tent flushed and knows
links.evidence: Jin Yuanbao remains bitter, harboring his own feelings for her

links.label: tries to leave her his savings before the battle, for his sister
links.evidence: he tried to entrust his life savings to her, asking her to deliver the money to his sister if he fell

links.label: dies shielding his brother from Sui Yuan Qing's blade
links.evidence: Man Di lunges forward to shield his brother and is fatally wounded by the blade

links.label: his strategist and closest friend — walks into the yamen with Luyuan's papers to save him
links.evidence: Gongsun Yin arrives just in time, presenting official documents proving Xie Zheng's affiliation with the prestigious Luyuan Academy

links.label: paints the three of them as a family; in camp, hides the Marquis from her
links.evidence: Moved by the sight, he painted a portrait of them and presented it to Changyu as a New Year's gift

links.label: the princess who came to his academy as a scholar, and the stranger he played chess with at Guangling Temple — one woman; he sends her away for the gap between them
links.evidence: Gongsun Yin realized with a shock that the woman he had felt a spiritual connection with through chess was actually the Princess

links.label: proposes a quiet life in Hejian; she asks for his family's library as betrothal gift
links.evidence: He proposes to Qi Shu, asking her to live a quiet life with him in Hejian once the conflict with Wei Yan and the Li family is resolved. Qi Shu eventually accepts

links.label: walks into the burning Qingyuan Palace and breathes her back to life
links.evidence: Gongsun Yin doused himself in water and charged into the flames to rescue Qi Shu. Finding that she had stopped breathing, he used an emergency resuscitation method

links.label: the Grand Tutor searching the quarries for his disciple 'Jiu Heng'
links.evidence: Tao described his disciple, Jiuheng, as a handsome and composed man

links.label: swaps his lot for hers so she leaves the dam that is meant to drown
links.evidence: Knowing that staying at the dam is a death sentence, Tao Yi tricks Changyu into swapping lots with him

links.label: adopts her as his sworn daughter and names her 'Shan Jun' — the tiger of the mountains
links.evidence: she knelt and formally accepted him as her sworn father. As a gift, he bestowed upon her the courtesy name "Shanjun"

links.label: Blood-Robed Cavalry guard
links.evidence: [Blood-Robed Cavalry guard]

links.label: takes Sui Tuo's spear for her; may never hold a blade again
links.evidence: Xie Wu intervenes and takes the blow, suffering a shattered shoulder bone to save her life

links.label: her father's old friend, who sends Wei Yan a tiger seal to keep the sisters safe
links.evidence: He Jingyuan sent an urgent message and a mysterious item to Chancellor Wei, acknowledging that the time had come to fulfill a long-held promise regarding the protection of his old friend's daughters

links.label: spars with her, recognises her father's blade work, gives her armor — his last farewell
links.evidence: He promised to reveal the full truth once the siege of Lucheng was over and presented her with a suit of custom-made armor

links.label: his mentor and commander; leaves him Jizhou and the Fan sisters to protect
links.evidence: He urged Li Huai'an to promise that if he were to pass away, Li would protect the Fan sisters

links.label: his father's old general; the dam at Wu River is their plan
links.evidence: Xie Zheng and Gongsun Yin met with He Jingyuan to propose a drowning strategy

links.label: trained beside him as boys; recognises the 'matrilocal husband' and asks whether he serves the Li or the Wei
links.evidence: Having studied martial arts and strategy alongside Xie Zheng years ago, he felt certain he recognized him despite the passage of time

links.label: the commandant who keeps saving her, and whose feelings the princess teases
links.evidence: He develops feelings for Fan Changyu.

links.label: sworn siblings, declared before both armies
links.evidence: He publicly declared that he and Fan Changyu had become sworn siblings

links.label: eldest grandson of the Grand Tutor — put under house arrest by him before the banquet
links.evidence: The Grand Tutor of the realm, he is also the grandfather of Li Huaian

links.label: his grandfather's ally, whom he finds unfit to rule
links.evidence: Li Huai'an and his subordinate, Xiao Zhu, lament that such a heartless man could never be a just ruler

links.label: maternal uncle — the Wei family's 'proper successor'
links.evidence: 大胤丞相，謝征舅舅

links.label: a hundred and eight lashes at his parents' graves, to buy the nephew free of the uncle
links.evidence: According to the family rules, an unfilial son must endure one hundred and eight lashes. Xie Zheng accepted the punishment willingly

links.label: exposes him as Jinzhou's true traitor with his mother's hidden letter, disarms him at the Xuan Gate, and hands him the poisoned wine himself
links.evidence: Xie Zheng accuses Wei Yan of being the true traitor of the Battle of Jinzhou, asserting that the Chancellor abandoned his soldiers at the front lines

links.label: sends the Mystic Iron Assassins to kill the Fan women and take a letter
links.evidence: the man confessed he was a Mystic Iron Assassin sent by Chancellor Wei to kill the women of the Fan family and retrieve a specific letter

links.label: his childhood love, forced into the palace by decree — a plea in her forged hand drew him from Jinzhou
links.evidence: The note revealed that Wei Yan had once been in a forbidden relationship with Qi Rongyin, who later became Consort Shu

links.label: the Wei clan and the Li clan, the two factions the emperor hangs between
links.evidence: After the session, the rivalry between the Chancellor and the Grand Tutor remains tense. Both sides are secretly searching for the missing Marquis

links.label: put him on the throne seventeen years ago and slaps him for scheming
links.evidence: He confronted Qi Sheng, slapping the Emperor across the face and warning him that this would be the last time he tolerated such schemes

links.label: raised as his son — not by blood, his mother confesses at the end
links.evidence: Wei Xuan, the son of Chancellor Wei, arrived to deliver a military order to He Jingyuan

links.label: resents the cousin the Wei family calls its proper successor
links.evidence: Wei Xuan's resentment toward Xie Zheng led to a confrontation with Wei Yan

links.label: takes Wei Sheng's arrow for him, for the mother Xie Zheng saved
links.evidence: Unexpectedly, Wei Xuan throws himself in the way, taking the hit to repay Xie Zheng for saving his mother earlier

links.label: her brother, the emperor she threatens with a stick
links.evidence: The Grand Princess of the realm, she is the sister to the current emperor

links.label: a marriage decreed for them by her brother — refused by both, the eunuch's ear cut off for it
links.evidence: Furious, Qi Shu accused the eunuchs of manipulating her brother and flatly rejected the proposal

links.label: the match their elders arrange; neither wants it, so they plan their freedom together
links.evidence: Both admitted they were uninterested in the marriage arranged by their elders, and the Princess suggested a plan that would allow them both to maintain their freedom

links.label: the physician 'Qi Bengong' who keeps the Marquis's secret and dresses the general in silks
links.evidence: Misunderstanding Qi Shu's royal self-reference, Changyu believes the physician's name is "Qi Bengong"

links.label: means to make her his Noble Consort, until she describes a pig's slaughter to him
links.evidence: When summoned to the palace, Qi Sheng attempts to woo her with poetry, but Changyu retaliates by graphically describing the process of slaughtering a pig
